title: the preview never prints a user line whose only change is the comma jitso's insertion adds after it
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup hook, defect N-17): jitso registers its guard in the project's .claude/settings.json without clobbering anything
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-17, setup hook). The last member of the root object (a plain key, or an inline array as prettier writes it) gains a trailing comma when jitso appends `hooks` after it, so a line diff shows that user line as removed and added even though jitso did not change its text. `.claude/settings.json` can hold secrets (AGENTS.md rule 1), so for this sensitive file the preview prints only lines jitso wrote: a user line that changes only by a comma shows as the one marker line `~ (a line of the existing file changes only by a comma; not shown)`, never its text.

stdout: ~ (a line of the existing file changes only by a comma; not shown)

stdout.regex: jitso setup hook: dry run, nothing written\n$
